title: Cable route rights
request: Please provide the executed deed(s) of easement for the export cable across Parcels 14 and 15 to Wickham Primary Substation.
why: Without these rights the site cannot physically connect to the grid.

title: Discharge of Condition 5
request: Please provide the Local Planning Authority’s written approval of the Construction Traffic Management Plan required by Condition 5.
why: Commencing before discharge risks invalidating the permission.

title: Confirm export capacity
request: Please confirm the intended export capacity and whether an increase to the 45 MW Maximum Export Capacity has been applied for.
why: Planning and the PPA assume 49.9 MW; the grid offer permits 45 MW.
documents_expected: Any variation to the connection offer
Correspondence with the network operator on capacity
